notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Patch 0.2.3
notes.content: [p]Another step forward in building your dream arcade! Patch [b]0.2.3[/b] brings new décor options, a brand-new shelf system for gachas, and a host of important fixes to make your arcade run smoother. This is the biggest update to the demo we've made so far. [/p][hr][/hr][h2]✨ Major Features[/h2][h3]🪩 Wall Décor – Lighting[/h3][p]Brighten up your arcade! You can now customize and add lighting décor to make your store stand out even more.[/p][h3]🗄️ Display Shelf System[/h3][p]Showcase your prized gachas! Players can now display gachas on shelves, and customers will buy directly from them when interested.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Minor Fixes & Improvements[/h2][p][b]Tutorial & UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed tutorial arrow not working properly for [b]Buy & Unlock Ninja Fighter[/b] and [b]Gacha Ball[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial overlapping on the [b]Pause Menu[/b] resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Mini-Game Instructions[/b] throughout the game (including end-of-day repair mini-game).[/p][/*][*][p]Move hover graphics to a layer below tablet apps.[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture App description now uses a plain font and includes proper product screen layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Added descriptions for machines and furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Store name now appears in the [b]Reviews App[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Balance on [b]Purchase Screen[/b] now updates correctly (previously showed 000).[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase screen shopping label made a [b]universal size[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]purchase screen negative balance[/b]: now shows [b]red text with “–” sign[/b] instead of brackets.[/p][/*][*][p]Options menu now has proper [b]SFX button clicks[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Pricing App (16:10) alignment fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]price change arrows[/b] to the Pricing App and Set Price window.[/p][/*][*][p]Pricing screen now shows [b]gacha elements[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture App alignment adjusted and [b]vertical scroll bar[/b] added.[/p][/*][*][p]Customisation screen text (walls & floors) is now [b]white[/b], with reduced button UI text size.[/p][/*][*][p]Walls & Floors customization now support [b]horizontal scroll wheel[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery notification properly aligned for [b]16:10 aspect ratio[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Display shelf description text fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Display shelf slot highlight is no longer visible from far away.[/p][/*][*][p]Gacha thumbnail resize fixed in Set Price window.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Neon Light[/b] price updated to 100.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Display Shelf[/b] price updated to 200.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs will not interact with a machine while the player is using it (e.g., gacha).[/p][/*][*][p]Customers waiting in line now leave after an hour instead of standing forever.[/p][/*][*][p]Customers will now [b]wait until repairs are finished[/b] before lining up again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where too many dissatisfied customers appeared.[/p][/*][*][p]If player has 2 counter tables, Redemption UI now works correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Redemption zoom bug (camera zooms into monitor when inserting tickets) fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Redemption NPC dialogue made generic, and NPC dialogue text reduced to [b]70% size[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When second counter table is removed, customers no longer walk to it.[/p][/*][*][p]Sell product now shows price properly (Sell for XYZ).[/p][/*][*][p]Next Day Delivery text notification fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]After dropping delivery boxes, hover contents no longer remain visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Daily Report screen now shows correct bought items (includes gacha balls, vending machine sodas, display shelf gachas).[/p][/*][*][p]"Items Bought" text updated to [b]"Items bought by customer"[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Systems & Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Dynamic Prices[/b] for all machines via City Layout Scene_Manager_MarketPrices.[/p][/*][*][p]Progressive unlock system for Furniture App items.[/p][/*][*][p]Online Shop:[/p][list][*][p]Shipping will no longer auto-select the first option on first purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]Divide [b]license costs[/b] by 10 for all items.[/p][/*][*][p]Divide [b]refill license[/b] costs by 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed “Express” shipping to [b]15%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed online shop purchase screen text issue.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced Redemption customers on [b]Day 1 & 2[/b] (and later).[/p][/*][*][p]When buying from online shop, shipping no longer auto-selects the first option.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Interactions & Mini-Games[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]SFX for soda refill[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added feedback text when pressing [b]Repair[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Repair mini-game instructions appear properly at end of day.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-games now have blur levels consistent with the gacha screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated cleaning mini-game model.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-game SFX added.[/p][/*][*][p]While holding a box and hovering over a display shelf, pressing R no longer incorrectly opens the Display Shelf collection app.[/p][/*][*][p]Holding a refill box now shows [b]quantity hover UI[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Display Shelf:[/p][list][*][p]When placing a gacha, price defaults to empty.[/p][/*][*][p]Box-up shelf disabled if a gacha is already present.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Other Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Customisation screen walls & floors text now [b]white[/b], with scroll support.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed UI to prevent tablet, hover effects, or head movement while Day End Report screen is open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where pressing space bar with gacha app open spawns extra gacha balls.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Retail Revamp[/b] UI.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔜 Coming in Patch 0.2.4[/h3][list][*][p][b]Claw Machine Gameplay & Collection Feature[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage Expansion[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage Rack System[/b] to organize delivery boxes[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.2
notes.content:
[p]Hey Arcade Managers![/p][p]We’re back with [b]Patch v0.2.2[/b], building on the repair and customization features introduced last update — plus tons of polish and community-requested bug fixes.[/p][p]Let’s dive into what’s new![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ [b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🧩 [b]New Repair Mini-Game[/b]
One more way to keep your arcade machines in top shape! Enjoy a fresh new interactive repair mechanic that keeps maintenance fun and engaging.[/p][/*][*][p]🏠 [b]Store Customization (Floors & Walls)[/b]
Give your arcade its own personality! You can now customize the [b]floor and wall styles[/b] to match your vibe and create the perfect arcade ambiance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Minor Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]✨ [b]Added Repair Particle Effects[/b] to make repairs feel more satisfying.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Mini-Game SFX[/b] — Repair and cleaning mini-games now come with sound effects for a better feel.[/p][/*][*][p]🧽 [b]Updated Model for Cleaning Mini-Game[/b] for a cleaner, more polished experience.[/p][/*][*][p]📋 [b]Instructions for Mini-Games[/b] have been added to help players understand what to do.[/p][/*][*][p]🎟️ [b]Redemption UI Fix[/b] — If you have two counter tables, the UI now correctly appears and functions.[/p][/*][*][p]🛑 [b]Box Pickup Movement Bug[/b] — Fixed issue where picking up boxes moved the player unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 [b]Repair Progress Saving[/b] — Your repair progress now saves properly, even between sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]🧍‍♂️ [b]Customers Standing at Removed Counters[/b] — Customers now stop visiting counters that have been removed. No more ghosts![/p][/*][*][p]🍹 [b]SFX Added for Soda Refilling[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Fixed [b]Tutorial UI from the Purchase Screen[/b] behaving incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]🔍 Fixed a [b]ticket counter zoom-in bug[/b] on Day 2 where clicking would result in a strange close-up.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 Coming in Patch 0.2.3[/h3][p]Here’s what’s on the way next:[/p][list][*][p]🖼️ [b]Wall Décor[/b]: Add posters, lighting, and more decorative elements.[/p][/*][*][p]🕹️ [b]Support for More Machine Types[/b]: Car racing, dance machines, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 [b]2-Player Machine Support[/b]: Including Air Hockey and 2P arcade cabinets.[/p][/*][*][p]🚧 [b]Fix for Counter Table Clipping Through Walls[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for all your feedback — every message and bug report helps shape the game into the ultimate arcade sim. Stay tuned for more fun soon![/p][p]👉 [b]Join our community on Discord:[/b]
🔗 [url="https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx"]https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx[/url][/p][p]See you in the next update! 💥[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.1
notes.content:
[p]Hey arcade owners![/p][p]We’re back with [b]Patch v0.2.1[/b], adding fresh features and continuing to squash bugs based on your feedback. This update introduces more [b]customization and interaction[/b], alongside a big batch of quality-of-life fixes to make your arcade management smoother and more fun![/p][p]Thank you for your continued support — let’s dive in![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 Major Features[/h3][list][*][p]🏷️ [b]Name Your Store[/b]
You can now [b]name your arcade[/b] — personalize your business and make it feel truly yours![/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Repair Machines[/b]
Broken machines? No worries! Introducing the new [b]Repair System[/b] featuring [b]two mini-games[/b] to fix up arcade machines and keep customers happy.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Minor Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]⚡ [b]Faster Coin Collecting[/b] — Coin collection speed has been increased for a snappier experience.[/p][/*][*][p]🎟️ Fixed issue where [b]Redemption UI wouldn’t appear[/b] when using [b]two counter tables[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🪙 Fixed player [b]movement while picking up boxes[/b] — no more getting stuck or walking through store glass![/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Added Repair Glyphs[/b] to clearly mark machines needing attention.[/p][/*][*][p]🚶‍♂️ Fixed [b]NPCs walking below the arcade surface[/b] — your customers should now stay properly grounded![/p][/*][*][p]💡 [b]Lighting fixes[/b] for upgrade stations — no more weird brightness issues.[/p][/*][*][p]🔔 [b]Added notification sounds[/b] for [b]deliveries[/b] and [b]full coin boxes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]💬 [b]NPC dialogue no longer gets cut off[/b] during interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Added option to [b]configure pointers[/b] in the [b]Settings Menu[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🥤 Added more [b]SFX[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Can filling sounds[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Trash can sound effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]General arcade interaction audio polish[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🏪 Fixed a [b]minor bug in the Retail Revamp app[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🎶 Fixed issue with [b]music cutting off abruptly[/b] during transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]🎟️Can work with 2 counter tables to redeem prizes[/p][/*][*][p]🪙Increase speed of coin collecting.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 Coming Soon in Patch 0.2.2[/h3][p]We’re already hard at work on the next update! Here’s a sneak peek:[/p][list][*][p]🏢 [b]Store customization[/b] with [b]flooring and wall options[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ [b]Wall décor[/b]: Posters, lighting, and more ways to make your arcade your own![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for sticking with us on this journey — each update is shaping Arcade Management Simulator into the ultimate arcade tycoon experience. Keep your feedback coming![/p][p]👉 [b]Join the community on Discord:[/b]
[/p][p]🔗 [url="https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx"]https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx[/url][/p][p][/p][p]More updates coming soon — see you in the arcade! 🎮[/p]

notes.title: 🕹️ Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]🎉 First Major Feature Update![/h3][p]Hey Arcade Managers![/p][p]We're excited to roll out [b]Patch v0.2.0[/b], the [b]first major feature update[/b] for Arcade Management Simulator! This update marks a big step forward — laying the foundation for deeper mechanics, smarter systems, and a more rewarding player experience.[/p][p]From financial control through loans, to a fully reworked retail and shipping system, this patch opens up new ways to grow, customize, and fine-tune your arcade empire. Let's dive in![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 Major New Features[/h3][list][*][p]🏦 [b]Bank Loan App[/b]
Need a cash boost? Take out [b]loans from the bank[/b] to upgrade, expand, and dominate faster. But be careful — interest adds up![/p][/*][*][p]🌟 [b]Customer Reviews System[/b]
Your arcade is now under the spotlight! Customers leave [b]reviews[/b] that influence foot traffic — better service = more customers!
Check out all the feedback in the new [b]Reviews App[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]Advanced Shipping System[/b]
The online shop now features [b]three shipping options[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Instant Delivery[/b] (costly but immediate)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Regular Delivery[/b] (balanced)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Next Day Free Delivery[/b] (budget-friendly, but delayed)
This adds a strategic layer to inventory planning and arcade stocking.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Minor Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]🖥️ Fixed [b]online shop UI[/b] scaling on different resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]🚶‍♂️ [b]NPC Walking Animation Fix[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⚖️ [b]Rebalanced machine and item pricing[/b] to feel more realistic.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ Fixed [b]hover glyphs[/b] not showing above regular trash cans.[/p][/*][*][p]🧾 [b]Pricing app[/b] now stays open unless intentionally closed — clicking inside won’t auto-close it.[/p][/*][*][p]🕒 Fixed issue where if you redeemed tickets right before a customer leaves, the [b]next customer’s pointer glitched[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 Redemption [b]prize numbers now round off correctly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🥤 Updated [b]refill dialogue[/b] for the soda machine to be clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ You can no longer [b]set prices on regular trash cans[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ Fixed [b]coin collection stutter[/b] due to performance hiccups.[/p][/*][*][p]🧲 Reduced [b]physics knockback[/b] caused by cola cans pushing the player.[/p][/*][*][p]🎲 Removed [b]small cube markers[/b] from in front of Gacha machines.[/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ Gacha ball display in [b]16:10 aspect ratio[/b] now renders correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 Gacha machines stacked on top of each other now [b]fill correctly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🧭 Tutorial pointer is now [b]disabled[/b] when the tablet is closed or the player is not in the redemption screen.[/p][/*][*][p]🛒 [b]Tutorial[/b] [b]Purchase pointer[/b] now consistently appears where it should.[/p][/*][*][p]📱 If the [b]tablet is open during end-of-day[/b], pressing enter now [b]closes it properly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]📚 Fixed [b]broken Gacha opening tutorial[/b] flow (Open → Add to Collection → View → Close).[/p][/*][*][p]⏹️ While viewing a Gacha model in the collection app, pressing [b]Escape now exits the viewer and app properly[/b], instead of opening the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented the same [b]NPC[/b] model visiting the store multiple times.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 What’s Next?[/h3][p]Patch 0.2.0 is just the beginning of the [b]feature phase[/b] of development. [/p][p]Stay tuned for future updates including in the next update:[/p][list][*][p]Machine repair system[/p][/*][*][p]Store customization (flooring & walls)[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Renovation App[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for being part of this incredible journey. Your feedback is what drives this project forward.
💬 [b]Join the discussion and help shape the game:[/b]
👉 [url="https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx"]https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx[/url][/p][p]We're just getting started — and the arcade is only going to get wilder from here. 🎮[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Demo Patch v0.1.5
notes.content:
[p]Hey Arcade Owners![/p][p]We’re thrilled to bring you [b]Patch v0.1.5[/b], a significant quality-of-life update that smooths out gameplay, fixes bugs, and improves core systems — all based on your awesome feedback.[/p][p]Thank you for continuing to support us and helping shape the future of [b]Arcade Management Simulator[/b]. We’re just warming up, and the next update will be our [b]first major feature drop[/b], but more on that at the end![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Major Fixes & Changes[/h3][list][*][p]⏳ [b]Redemption Queue Timeout[/b]
Customers waiting [b]more than 1 hour[/b] at the redemption counter will now [b]leave the queue[/b], and you’ll earn [b]reduced XP[/b] for delayed service.[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]Sell Machines / Box Up Feature Added[/b]
You can now [b]box up or sell machines[/b] directly from your arcade — time to declutter and earn back some cash![/p][/*][*][p]🎓 [b]Gacha Tutorial Moved to Day 1[/b]
The Gacha tutorial now triggers [b]after[/b] the ticket and coin collection tutorial — for a smoother learning flow.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]Settings Menu Bug Fixed[/b]
Changing settings now [b]properly applies changes across all game systems[/b]. Your preferences will stick as expected![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Minor Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]🕹️ Updated tutorial to instruct players to go to the [b]machine with the exclamation mark[/b] (Ninja Fighter).[/p][/*][*][p]🚶‍♂️ Increased [b]walking speed[/b] to [b]6[/b] for faster arcade navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]🪟 Fixed issue where [b]Gacha machines appeared transparent[/b] when viewed from outside the arcade.[/p][/*][*][p]📱 [b]Tablet apps enabled[/b] with proper overlays now active.[/p][/*][*][p]🏷️ Increased [b]sticker size[/b] on refill boxes. Changed quantity display format to: [b]8/15[/b]. Switched color to [b]black[/b] for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]🥷 Ninja Fighter machine now starts at [b]70% full[/b] on Day 1.[/p][/*][*][p]❌ Replaced “Collect them all” prompt in Gacha with a new prompt: [b]"Press ESC to leave the Gacha Machine."[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Added tooltip: [b]"Click and hold left click inside the green highlight to collect coins from the Gacha Machine."[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Fixed bug where the [b]mouse pointer disappeared[/b] if you were at the redemption counter and the day ended. It now stays visible.[/p][/*][*][p]💚 Adjusted [b]green coin highlight[/b] to avoid overlapping with Gacha characters (based on your video feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]🚪 Fixed issue where [b]customers walked through closed doors[/b] after redeeming tickets post-day-end.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ [b]Trash bin[/b] can no longer be placed or moved while in the redemption screen.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ Fixed bug where selecting [b]Q[/b] on the trash bin [b]duplicated it in multiple places[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 Coming Soon: First Feature Update[/h3][p]Get ready — our next major update will introduce [b]new gameplay systems[/b] and deeper arcade management tools. Here's what to expect in [b]Patch v0.2.0[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]🏪 [b]Retail System Revamp[/b] – Overhauled backend for smoother store operations.[/p][/*][*][p]🏦 [b]Bank Loan App[/b] – Take loans to expand your arcade empire.[/p][/*][*][p]🌟 [b]Customer Reviews System[/b] – Hear what players love (and hate) about your arcade.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Machine Repair System[/b] – Fix up broken machines to avoid downtime.[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Store Customization[/b] – Personalize your arcade with [b]flooring and wall options[/b]![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey. Your feedback continues to shape the game and push it forward. We’re just getting started — and the best is yet to come![/p][p]👉 [b]Join our official Discord community[/b] to share your ideas, report bugs, and hang out with fellow arcade enthusiasts:
🔗 [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx"]https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time — keep managing and keep playing! 🕹️[/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Demo Update v0.1.4
notes.content:
[p]Hey Arcade Managers![/p][p]We’re back with another important update to improve your arcade-running experience. [b]Version 0.1.4[/b] focuses on fixing persistent Gacha issues, improving tutorial clarity, smoothing out UI feedback, and introducing some quality-of-life upgrades — all thanks to your continued support and suggestions![/p][p]As always, a massive thank you for being part of this journey. Your feedback during and after Steam Next Fest has been incredible. Keep it coming![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Major Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]🎰 [b]Top Gacha Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Top-row Gacha machines are now [b]movable[/b] again.[/p][/*][*][p]Gacha machines on top [b]no longer go missing[/b] after saving and reloading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit that let players [b]duplicate Gacha machines[/b] when snapping one next to another.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🎵 [b]Consistent Music Volume[/b][/p][list][*][p]Game and pause menu music volumes now match.[/p][/*][*][p]Both soundtracks are now normalized for consistent in-game audio levels.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]⏭️ [b]Gacha Interaction Fix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ending the day mid-Gacha opening will now correctly [b]exit Gacha mode[/b] the next day instead of opening the pause menu.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🟩 [b]Better Visual Feedback[/b][/p][list][*][p]Gacha machines now show a [b]green outline when needing a refill or coin collection[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Vending machines now have a [b]coin box highlight[/b] for easier coin collection.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]Toggle Fullscreen Button Activated[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now toggle fullscreen mode directly from the settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🖱️ [b]Pointer & End-of-Day Screen UI Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The circle pointer no longer disappears after the day ends.[/p][/*][*][p]End-of-day message has been [b]moved lower[/b] to avoid blocking interaction.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Smaller Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Disabled [b]Miscellaneous[/b] and [b]Sort[/b] buttons in the Online Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled all [b]"Coming Soon"[/b] apps in the tablet.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed [b]font color for level requirements[/b] in the Online Shop for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated ticket redemption tutorial text to include [b]“(or more)”[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Made [b]tutorial arrows larger[/b] and placed them in more visible spots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gacha refill[/b] and [b]soda can refill[/b] now display the [b]number of products per box[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial now clarifies: [b]"Click and hold"[/b] when inserting tickets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced number of customers[/b] at the redemption counter on Day 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Ensured [b]Ninja Fighter machine[/b] fills up first on Day 1 instead of Gacha.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a prompt to show [b]‘C’ for crouch[/b] when near a Gacha machine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced cost of the Trash Can[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled all [b]Auction buttons[/b] in the [i]My Gacha Collection[/i] app.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 Coming Soon in v0.1.5[/h3][p]We're already working hard on the next update!
